steps: 1. Enter a valid Email into the Email field
2. Enter the valid Password into the Password field
3. Double-click the Login button rapidly (two clicks in quick succession)
test_cases.expected_result: Only a single authentication attempt is processed and a single redirect to the dashboard occurs; the form submission effectively succeeds once (no duplicate redirects or duplicate sessions are created)

test_cases.test_case: User cancels Google OAuth popup before completing authentication
steps: 1. Click the Social_Login_Google button
2. When the OAuth popup appears, immediately close the popup (cancel) before completing any provider authentication
3. Observe the main login page
test_cases.expected_result: OAuth cancellation blocks authentication: no authentication occurs and no redirect happens (authentication is blocked); the main login page remains visible and the user is not signed in

test_cases.test_case: Request reset link for an existing email
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter <existing email> in the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
test_cases.expected_result: sends reset link to the provided email and shows a confirmation message

test_cases.test_case: Request reset link for a non-existent email shows error and keeps form editable
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter <nonexistent email> in the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
test_cases.expected_result: shows error 'email not found' and keeps the form editable

test_cases.test_case: Change password using a valid reset link (matching passwords)
preconditions: User has a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: 1. Open the Password Reset page using the valid reset link
2. Enter <new password> in the New Password field
3. Enter <new password> in the Confirm Password field
4. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: changes password and redirects to the login page with a success message

test_cases.test_case: Submit Forgot Password with Email left blank
preconditions: User is on the Forgot Password page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Leave the Email field blank
3. Click the Reset Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Email field indicating it is required; the form does not submit and no confirmation message is shown; user remains on the Forgot Password page with the Email field editable.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Forgot Password with invalid email format
preconditions: User is on the Forgot Password page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter <invalid email format> into the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Email field displays an inline format validation error (e.g. 'Enter a valid email address'); the form does not submit and no confirmation or 'email not found' error appears; user remains on the Forgot Password page.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Forgot Password with non-existent email (email not found)
preconditions: User is on the Forgot Password page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter <email not in system> into the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows error 'email not found' and the form remains editable; no reset link is sent and the user is not redirected.

test_cases.test_case: Change Password: New Password left blank (required)
preconditions: User opens the Password Reset page using <valid reset link>
steps: 1. Open the Password Reset page using <valid reset link>
2. Leave the New_Password field blank
3. Enter <matching password> into the Confirm_Password field
4. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the New_Password field indicating it is required; the form does not submit; the password is not changed; user remains on the Password Reset page.

test_cases.test_case: Change Password: submit with ALL required password fields empty
preconditions: User opens the Password Reset page using <valid reset link>
steps: 1. Open the Password Reset page using <valid reset link>
2. Leave the New_Password field blank
3. Leave the Confirm_Password field blank
4. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on both New_Password and Confirm_Password fields indicating they are required; the form does not submit; the password is not changed; user remains on the Password Reset page.

test_cases.test_case: Change Password: Confirm Password does not match New Password
preconditions: User opens the Password Reset page using <valid reset link>
steps: 1. Open the Password Reset page using <valid reset link>
2. Enter <new password> into the New_Password field
3. Enter <different password> into the Confirm_Password field
4. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Confirm_Password field displays an inline error indicating it must match New_Password (e.g. 'must match New Password'); the form does not submit; the password is not changed; user remains on the Password Reset page.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt Change Password using an expired reset link
preconditions: User opens the Password Reset page using <expired reset link>
steps: 1. Open the Password Reset page using <expired reset link>
2. Enter <new password> into the New_Password field
3. Enter <matching new password> into the Confirm_Password field
4. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Change is blocked due to invalid/expired link; a visible error message appears stating the reset link is invalid or expired (e.g. 'Reset link is invalid or expired'); the password is not changed and the user is not redirected to the login page.

test_cases.test_case: Access Password Reset page without a reset token (precondition not met)
preconditions: User is not using a reset link (navigates to the Password Reset URL without token)
steps: 1. Navigate directly to the Password Reset page URL without a reset token
2. Observe the page contents before interacting with any fields
test_cases.expected_result: Page immediately shows an error indicating the reset link is invalid or missing (e.g. 'Reset link is invalid or expired') or redirects to the Forgot Password page; New_Password and Confirm_Password fields and the Change Password button are not available for use; no password change can be attempted.

test_cases.test_case: Open reset link at exactly 24 hours after it was sent (boundary of expiry)
preconditions: There is an existing user account whose email is accessible to the tester
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter the existing account's email in the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
4. In the received reset email, wait until exactly 24 hours after the email timestamp, then click the reset link
5. On the Password Reset page, enter a value in the New_Password field
6. Enter the identical value in the Confirm_Password field
7. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Opening the link at exactly 24 hours succeeds; submitting matching passwords succeeds — the system changes the password and redirects to the login page with a visible success message.

test_cases.test_case: Open reset link just past expiry (one minute after 24-hour expiration) — past-boundary
preconditions: There is an existing user account whose email is accessible to the tester
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter the existing account's email in the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
4. In the received reset email, wait until 24 hours plus one minute after the email timestamp, then click the reset link
5. Observe the page content
test_cases.expected_result: Opening the link is blocked / error shown; the UI displays a visible error indicating the reset link has expired and the Password Reset form is not displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Password Reset when Confirm_Password exactly matches New_Password (matching boundary)
preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset link is open on the Password Reset page
steps: 1. On the Password Reset page, enter a value in the New_Password field
2. Enter the exact same value in the Confirm_Password field
3. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Submission succeeds; the system changes the password and redirects to the login page with a visible success message.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Password Reset when Confirm_Password differs by one character (just-past matching boundary)
preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset link is open on the Password Reset page
steps: 1. On the Password Reset page, enter a value in the New_Password field
2. Enter a value in the Confirm_Password field that differs from New_Password by one character
3. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Submission is blocked / error shown; the Confirm_Password field displays an inline error 'must match New_Password' and the form remains editable on the Password Reset page.

test_cases.test_case: Request reset with leading/trailing whitespace around an existing email
preconditions: There is an existing user account whose email is accessible to the tester
steps: 1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page
2. Enter the existing account's email including leading and trailing whitespace in the Email field
3. Click the Reset Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; the Reset Password action succeeds — a reset link is sent to the trimmed email address and a confirmation message is shown. The form UI shows the confirmation message and does not display an 'email not found' error.

test_cases.test_case: Use Unicode / emoji characters in New_Password and Confirm_Password on reset page
preconditions: A valid, unexpired reset link is open on the Password Reset page
steps: 1. On the Password Reset page, enter a password containing Unicode characters (e.g., emoji and non-ASCII characters) in the New_Password field
2. Enter the identical Unicode-containing password in the Confirm_Password field
3. Click the Change Password button
test_cases.expected_result: Submission succeeds (if Unicode passwords are supported); the system changes the password and redirects to the login page with a visible success message. If Unicode is not supported, an inline error is shown indicating invalid characters and submission is blocked.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Hotels Search form and navigate to Listing Page
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination> in the Destination field
2. Enter <valid check-in> in the Check_in field
3. Enter <valid check-out> in the Check_out field (after Check_in)
4. Enter <number of rooms> in the Rooms field
5. Enter <number of adults> in the Adults field
6. Click Search
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Listing Page

test_cases.test_case: Remove a single active filter from the Active Filters summary
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Price Range filter (if collapsed)
3. Enter <min price> in Price_Min and/or <max price> in Price_Max to create an active filter
4. Verify the active filter labeled '<filter label>' appears in the Active Filters summary
5. Click Remove on the active filter labeled '<filter label>' in the Active Filters summary
test_cases.expected_result: The active filter '<filter label>' is no longer shown in the Active Filters summary; results update dynamically to reflect the removed filter

test_cases.test_case: Reset all active filters from the Active Filters summary

2. Apply at least two filters (e.g., set Price_Min and select a Star_Ratings checkbox)
3. Verify multiple active filters appear in the Active Filters summary
4. Click the Reset all button in the Active Filters summary
test_cases.expected_result: clears all filters and updates results dynamically

test_cases.test_case: Sort results by Price (low to high)
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Select 'Price (low to high)' from the Sort by dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results are sorted by price ascending; the Results Grid displays hotels ordered from lowest to highest starting price

test_cases.test_case: Sort results by Price (high to low)
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Select 'Price (high to low)' from the Sort by dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results are sorted by price descending; the Results Grid displays hotels ordered from highest to lowest starting price

test_cases.test_case: Sort results by Star rating
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Select 'Star rating' from the Sort by dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results are sorted by Star rating; hotels with higher star ratings appear before lower-rated hotels in the Results Grid

test_cases.test_case: Sort results by Guest rating
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Select 'Guest rating' from the Sort by dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results are sorted by Guest rating; hotels with higher guest ratings appear before lower-rated hotels in the Results Grid

test_cases.test_case: Expand the Price Range filter group
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Click the Toggle Price Filter button
test_cases.expected_result: Price Range filter group expands showing Price_Min and Price_Max fields

test_cases.test_case: Expand the Star Rating filter group
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Click the Toggle Star Rating Filter button
test_cases.expected_result: Star Rating filter group expands showing rating checkboxes

test_cases.test_case: Expand the Facilities/Amenities filter group
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Click the Toggle Facilities/Amenities Filter button
test_cases.expected_result: Facilities/Amenities filter group expands showing Amenities checkboxes

test_cases.test_case: Expand the Hotel Type filter group
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Click the Toggle Hotel Type Filter button
test_cases.expected_result: Hotel Type filter group expands showing Hotel_Type checkboxes

test_cases.test_case: Expand the Board Basis filter group
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Click the Toggle Board Basis Filter button
test_cases.expected_result: Board Basis filter group expands showing the Board_Basis dropdown

test_cases.test_case: Set a minimum price and observe results update
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Price Range filter (if collapsed)
3. Enter <min price> in Price_Min
test_cases.expected_result: Results update dynamically to reflect the applied minimum price; an active filter labeled '<filter label>' for the minimum price appears in the Active Filters summary

test_cases.test_case: Set a maximum price and observe results update
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Price Range filter (if collapsed)
3. Enter <max price> in Price_Max
test_cases.expected_result: Results update dynamically to reflect the applied maximum price; an active filter labeled '<filter label>' for the maximum price appears in the Active Filters summary

test_cases.test_case: Select a Star rating filter and verify results update
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Star Rating filter (if collapsed)

test_cases.expected_result: Results update dynamically to show hotels matching the selected star rating(s); the Active Filters summary shows a filter labeled '<filter label>' for the selected star rating(s)

steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Facilities/Amenities filter (if collapsed)
3. Select the <desired amenity> checkbox in Amenities
test_cases.expected_result: Results update dynamically to show hotels offering the selected amenity; the Active Filters summary shows a filter labeled '<filter label>' for the selected amenity

test_cases.test_case: Select a Hotel Type filter and verify results update
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Hotel Type filter (if collapsed)
3. Select the <desired hotel type> checkbox in Hotel_Type
test_cases.expected_result: Results update dynamically to show hotels of the selected hotel type; the Active Filters summary shows a filter labeled '<filter label>' for the selected hotel type

test_cases.test_case: Select a Board Basis option and verify results update
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Expand the Board Basis filter (if collapsed)
3. Select <board basis option> from the Board_Basis dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Results update dynamically to show hotels matching the selected board basis; the Active Filters summary shows a filter labeled '<filter label>' for the selected board basis

test_cases.test_case: Click Book Now on a hotel card and navigate to booking/details page
steps: 1. Enter <valid destination>, <valid check-in> and <valid check-out> and click Search to open Listing Page
2. Locate a hotel card in the Results Grid and click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: navigates to hotel booking/details page

test_cases.test_case: Search blocked when Check_out is on or before Check_in
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form page
steps: 1. Enter <check-in date> into the Check_in field
2. Enter <check-out date on or before check-in> into the Check_out field
3. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Check_out field stating that Check_out must be after Check_in (constraint: 'Check_out must be after Check_in'); the Search form does not submit and the user remains on the Search page (no redirect to Listing Page).

test_cases.test_case: Invalid date format entered into Check_in is rejected
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form page
steps: 1. Enter <invalid date format> into the Check_in field
2. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Check_in field indicating the value is not a valid date (e.g., 'Enter a valid date'); the form does not submit and the user is not redirected to the Listing Page.

test_cases.test_case: Non-numeric input rejected in Rooms numeric field
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form page
steps: 1. Enter <non-numeric input> into the Rooms field
2. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Rooms field indicating it must be a number; the Search action is blocked and the user remains on the Search page (no redirect to Listing Page).

test_cases.test_case: Price range rejected when Price_Min is greater than Price_Max
preconditions: User has navigated to the Listing Page (a previous successful search was performed)
steps: 1. Click the Toggle Price Filter button to expand the Price Range filter group
2. Enter <price value greater than Price_Max> into the Price_Min field
3. Enter <price value less than Price_Min> into the Price_Max field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Price_Min / Price_Max fields indicating the constraint 'Price_Min must be less than or equal to Price_Max'; the filter values are not applied and results do not update dynamically while the invalid values remain (no filter is applied).

test_cases.test_case: Non-numeric input rejected in Price_Min filter field
preconditions: User is on the Listing Page with Price Range filter expanded
steps: 1. Enter <non-numeric input> into the Price_Min field
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Price_Min field indicating the value must be numeric; results are not updated and the invalid input is prevented from applying as a filter.

test_cases.test_case: Book Now button not available on Search form page (precondition not met)
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form page (has not submitted a search)
steps: 1. View the Search form page
2. Attempt to locate or click a 'Book Now' button on the page
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Book Now' button is not present/visible on the Search form page (Book Now exists only on hotel cards on the Listing Page); the user cannot click through to a hotel booking/details page from the Search form.

test_cases.test_case: Check-out exactly one day after Check-in (allowed)
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form
steps: 1. Enter a valid date in the Check_in field
2. Enter <one day after Check_in> in the Check_out field
3. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Search succeeds; user is redirected to the Listing Page and results are shown for the selected date range

test_cases.test_case: Check-out equal to Check-in (same-day) is blocked when Check_out must be after Check_in
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form
steps: 1. Enter a valid date in the Check_in field
2. Enter the same date in the Check_out field (Check_out = Check_in)
3. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Search is blocked; an inline error is shown near Check_out indicating Check_out must be after Check_in

test_cases.test_case: Price_Min equal to Price_Max (boundary equality allowed)
preconditions: User is on the Listing Page with the Filters Sidebar visible
steps: 1. Expand the Price Range filter group if collapsed
2. Enter a numeric value in the Price_Min field
3. Enter the same numeric value in the Price_Max field (Price_Min = Price_Max)
test_cases.expected_result: Setting Price_Min equal to Price_Max succeeds; results update dynamically and Active Filters Summary shows a single price-range filter representing the selected value

test_cases.test_case: Price_Min greater than Price_Max is blocked
preconditions: User is on the Listing Page with the Filters Sidebar visible
steps: 1. Expand the Price Range filter group if collapsed
2. Enter a numeric value in the Price_Max field
3. Enter a numeric value in the Price_Min field that is <one unit greater than Price_Max>
test_cases.expected_result: Setting Price_Min > Price_Max is blocked; an inline error is shown near the Price_Min/Price_Max controls indicating Price_Min must be less than or equal to Price_Max

test_cases.test_case: Very long Destination string (200+ characters) submitted
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) in the Destination field
2. Fill other required fields as needed for search (or leave optional fields blank)
3. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Search submits successfully and user is redirected to the Listing Page; the Active Filters Summary displays the Destination value (if the UI truncates the value a visible truncation/ellipsis is shown) — overall search action succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Destination input with leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed on save/display
preconditions: User is on the Hotels Search form
steps: 1. Enter a Destination value with leading and trailing spaces in the Destination field
2. Click the Search button
test_cases.expected_result: Search succeeds; Listing Page is shown and the Active Filters Summary displays the Destination value with leading/trailing whitespace trimmed (no extra spaces visible)

test_cases.test_case: Apply multiple filters then use Reset all to remove them (Repeating group clears to zero items)
preconditions: User is on the Listing Page
steps: 1. Expand at least two different filter groups (e.g., Star Rating and Amenities)
2. Select one or more values in the Star_Ratings filter
3. Select one or more values in the Amenities filter
4. Observe Active Filters Summary shows multiple filter items
5. Click the Reset all button in the Active Filters Summary or Filters Sidebar
test_cases.expected_result: Reset all succeeds; all filters are cleared and results update dynamically; Active Filters Summary is empty (no filter items shown)

test_cases.test_case: Select a room from the Room Types list opens the booking form
preconditions: Room Types list is visible with available room rows
steps: 1. Click 'Select Room' on a room in the Room Types list
test_cases.expected_result: opens Booking Form with selected room

test_cases.test_case: Booking form shows price breakdown for selected dates and guest count

test_cases.test_case: Complete booking with valid inputs while logged in redirects to Payment page
steps: 1. Click 'Select Room' on a room in the Room Types list to open the Booking Form
2. Verify Selected Hotel and Selected Room Type are prefilled in the Booking Form
3. Enter <checkin date> in the Checkin Date field
4. Enter <checkout date> in the Checkout Date field (after <checkin date>)

test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Payment page

test_cases.test_case: Leave a required text/unspecified field blank (First Name) and submit
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Leave the First_Name field blank
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First_Name field indicating it is required; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Leave a required date field blank (Checkin Date) and submit
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Leave the Checkin_Date field blank
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Checkin_Date field indicating it is required; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Leave a required number field blank (Guest Count) and submit
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Leave the Guest_Count field blank
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Guest_Count field indicating it is required; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Leave the required email field blank and submit
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Leave the Email field blank
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Email field indicating it is required; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Submit Booking Form with ALL required fields empty
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Clear or leave all required fields empty (Selected_Hotel, Selected_Room_Type, Checkin_Date, Checkout_Date, Guest_Count, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, Phone_Number)

test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on all required fields (Selected_Hotel, Selected_Room_Type, Checkin_Date, Checkout_Date, Guest_Count, First_Name, Last_Name, Email, Phone_Number) indicating they are required; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Checkout date is on or before Checkin date (constraint violation)
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>

3. Enter <checkout date that is on or before the checkin date> in Checkout_Date
4. Fill all other required fields with valid values

4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on Guest_Count with the constraint message: "must be >= 1"; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Guest_Count exceeds selected room maximum occupancy
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room> whose maximum occupancy is <max occupancy>
2. Enter <a value greater than selected room maximum occupancy> in Guest_Count
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on Guest_Count with the constraint message: "must be <= selected room maximum occupancy"; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Non-numeric input in numeric field (Guest_Count)
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Enter <non-numeric input> into the Guest_Count field
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on Guest_Count indicating a numeric value is required (Guest_Count field displays an inline error indicating a numeric value is required); form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Invalid email format in Email field
steps: 1. Open the Booking Form for <selected room>
2. Enter <invalid email format> into the Email field
3. Fill all other required fields with valid values
4. Click the Book Now button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Email field with the constraint message: "must be a valid email address"; form does not submit; user is not redirected to Payment page; booking is not created.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open Booking Form (Select Room) without selecting a room
preconditions: On Hotel Details page (Room Types list visible)
User may be logged out or logged in
